name: NICAEA
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (Hymns Ancient and Modern, 1861/1869); every note agrees with the score on Wikipedia's article and the opening with hymnary.org's incipit.
reviewNotes: High. 'Lord', 'morn-' and the third 'ho-' are each held two beats (books that fit other verses' extra syllables print them as two tied crotchets). Hymns A&M has it in D; many American books in Eb, with the same solfa.
